meta.triageRationale: Small: one module plus a new vscode-free placement function.

body.summary: A new review pane opens in an editor group that is already open and holds no chat tab; with none it opens where it did (beside the chat without focus when quiet, the active group otherwise). New vscode-free chat/review-column.ts: chooseReviewColumn(groups, chatViewType) leaves out every group with a tab satisfying group-lock.ts's isChatTabInput, then returns the active group's column, else the lowest, else undefined. extension.ts's review host createPanel reads vscode.window.tabGroups.all in a try (a throw is logged and gives today's placement) and passes the column, or today's placement. The compile-only vscode.d.ts shim gained TabGroups.all and TabGroup.viewColumn, isActive and tabs. Tests: review-column.test.ts (fake groups), and the two existing source scans in review-wiring.test.ts rewritten for the new wiring (the iconPath test and the presenter-wiring test, whose title now states the new placement). Tests run file by file: 1357 tests, 2 failures (the manifest-catalog tests that were already failing). NOT SEEN IN A REAL VS CODE: whether VS Code puts the pane into the chosen group, and what the 'active group' is when the chat group is locked, are untested; extension.ts cannot run outside VS Code.
